description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your heart has opened up, making you feel connected to everyone around you. You're no longer able to ignore the pain and suering around you. You still have self-preservation, but the well being and dignity of others is something that moves you deeply. Hence you are self-sacri cing and view things from the lens o what you can give to the world. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.oGbDwnLOn3isPJpO]{Impassioned Zeal} Talent. You have a hard time steeling yourself towards the plight of others, and you care deeply about the wellbeing or dignity of others. You may sometimes make sacri ces at your own expense for the greater good. You gain -10 on Tests to hurt or exploit the weaknesses of other people, and +10 on Tests of helping or showing kindness towards others. People around you may take note of any unusually self-sacrificing behaviour (see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-mutations.mutations-journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}). You cannot gain this mutation if you already have @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-mutations.items.Item.DPCJjHOXER1wpqno]{Unending Malice}.
